The generic LRU cache in this repository (`lru.go`, package `lru`) has two kinds of problems that its users report.

1. It does not always evict the least recently used entry: entries that were just used can be evicted while older, untouched ones survive.
2. It is shared by many goroutines in our server, but under concurrent use `go test -race` reports data races, and without the race detector the process sometimes dies with "concurrent map read and map write".

Fix `lru.go` so that the cache behaves exactly as README.md specifies, without changing its public API. `lru_test.go` holds the README examples and a small concurrent test; do not edit any *_test.go file. Run the tests with `go test -race -timeout 60s ./...` (the timeout turns a deadlock into a failure instead of a hang). More tests than the visible ones, covering the rest of the README and heavier concurrent use, are run when your work is checked.
